C10_event_ids_unique_and_no_double_credi.evidence_level: real data exercised uniqueness and single-credit; a re-dispatch of the same accepted event does not occur in these eight episodes, so idempotency under duplication rests on the credited_task_ids guard plus ROUND34's synthetic re-publication test and this round's own pure wiring test, not on real data

C2_task_stream_written_at_the_event_tick.note: every credit is written at the tick the event was published on, and a tick with several completions carries that many units

C3_clock_ordering_observed.interpretation: the contract says clock.now is still the pre-step time while the event already carries the post-step time; this is an observation of that ordering, not a pass/fail criterion, because the collector never reads or writes the clock

C4_ownership_recomputed_with_the_real_bu.note: the ownership test uses v2_trainer._bundle itself on this round's own rows and tapes; no second implementation of the bucketing rule is introduced here

cases_the_block_cannot_reach: cross_tick_no_new_action (0 of 4281 archived credits and 0 here: every completion happens on a tick that has a decision row)
before_first_action_prefix (relay ticks start at 1 and the policy decides at tick 1)

per_rule.rule_1_status_is_completed: every ledger row comes from a COMPLETED event: the collector returns before recording for any other status

C7_registered_prediction_falsification.note: episodes 0..3 run before any weight moves, so they are directly comparable with the archived legacy run; the prediction (every archived key shifted back one tick) is falsifiable and is tested here

C8_tail_and_termination.capture_is_immediate_because: each credited tick equals the tick the event was published on (C2), so a completion on the last executed tick is written during that same publication and needs no later step; the closure on_time == credited_total then proves nothing was dropped at the tail

C9_deadline_expiry_never_credits.mechanism: the collector's first guard is `status is not COMPLETED`, so an expired target produces neither a credit nor a ledger row; the deadline guard is a second layer that real data in this block never reaches (0 archived completions after a deadline)
